title: break and continue
instructions: Two keywords give you extra control inside loops:
- break — leave the loop immediately, even if it wasn't finished.
- continue — skip the rest of THIS turn and jump to the next one.
They're handy for stopping early or skipping certain values.
In this lesson, we skip printing the number 3 using continue.
task: Add the continue so the loop prints 1, 2, 4, 5 (skipping 3).
